title: Pro Strategy to Grow Fast
subtitle: Multiple shops, eHunt, Etsy Ads and business growth

items.title: Visible, no orders?
items.text: Review the offer and account performance

items.title: Around $100 earned
items.text: Then consider a second shop (class suggestion)

sections.heading: Multiple shops: the class vs Etsy's published rules

columns.title: In class
items: "One IP, one account": separate device, connection and access
Proxies or RDP, roughly 1,000 to 3,000; no VPN
Teacher's technical claims, not Etsy requirements

columns.title: Etsy says
items: A separate account and email per shop
List all your shops in each public profile

parts.heading: Weekly eHunt loop
items: Find Hot Product: search e.g. Bill Tracker
Use them as inspiration; create your own
Only 2 to 4 sellers selling? Consider another keyword

parts.heading: Test Etsy Ads
items: Review after 7 days; keep listings that sold
Etsy recommends at least 30 days to evaluate
Optional test: $1 for 6 hours, off, on again

sections.quote: Mistakes and ups and downs are part of building a business.
sections.text: Keep learning and improving instead of expecting instant success.

title: The Etsy Ranking Funnel
subtitle: SEO only brings impressions; the rest of the funnel earns the ranking

sections.quote: Clicks under 10% of impressions? The funnel is poor.
sections.text: If impressions come but clicks do not, nobody buys.

items.title: Consistency
items.text: 2 or 3 quality listings daily; minimum 1 every 2 to 3 days.

items.title: 30-listing checkpoint
items.text: Track impressions, clicks, favorites, orders, keywords.

items.title: Reviews
items.text: After-sales support, then ask a happy buyer.

items.title: Never fake orders
items.text: Bring real traffic from Pinterest instead.

sections.text: Also taught: a website with 5,000 monthly traffic can sell digital products or earn from ads, then be flipped after 6 months.
